channel.title: Behold the Lamb Presents
channel.desc: The prophet Isaiah reminds each of us in chapter 66 and verse 23 that, it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord. Our God is lovingly calling His children to come and spend sacred time with Him in worship each week on the seventh day. And yet, most of Christendom has forgotten. And even those that do remember, often treat the day lightly with little regard to its sanctity.
